name: @godlevski/source
description: godlevski.com v3 — cloudflare monorepo (R2 + D1 + Workers)
author: Dmitriy Godlevski

scripts.dev: ENV_MODE=development concurrently --names "proxy,fe:god,fe:art,wk:api" --c "bgWhite,bgBlue,bgMagenta,bgGreen" "pnpm tsx watch local-runner.ts" "cd frontend/godlevski && pnpm dev" "cd frontend/art-godlevski && pnpm dev" "cd workers/godlevski-api && pnpm dev"
scripts.lint: concurrently --names "fe:god,fe:art,wk:api,wk:r2,wk:ar2" --c "bgBlue,bgMagenta,bgGreen,bgYellow,bgCyan" "cd frontend/godlevski && pnpm lint" "cd frontend/art-godlevski && pnpm lint" "cd workers/godlevski-api && pnpm lint" "cd workers/godlevski-r2 && pnpm lint" "cd workers/art-godlevski-r2 && pnpm lint"
scripts.deploy:fe:godlevski: cd frontend/godlevski && pnpm build && bash ../../infra/deploy-frontend.sh godlevski
scripts.deploy:fe:art-godlevski: cd frontend/art-godlevski && pnpm build && bash ../../infra/deploy-frontend.sh art-godlevski
